skills.title: Accessible Interface
skills.description: Design and review inclusive interfaces for keyboard, screen-reader, cognitive, and visual access.

skills.title: Color and Contrast
skills.description: Build purposeful interface color roles with legible contrast, clear states, and restrained emphasis.

skills.title: Design Context
skills.description: Capture the product, users, constraints, and design direction before making interface decisions.

skills.title: Layout and Spacing
skills.description: Create coherent interface layouts and spacing systems that preserve relationships across screen sizes.

skills.title: Typography
skills.description: Choose and tune interface typography for readable hierarchy, rhythm, density, and resilient content.

skills.title: Visual Hierarchy
skills.description: Strengthen interface hierarchy so attention, reading order, and primary actions are immediately clear.

skills.title: Design System Audit
skills.description: Audit a design system for token, component, accessibility, documentation, and adoption inconsistencies.

skills.title: Forms and Validation
skills.description: Design and review forms that reduce effort, prevent errors, explain recovery, and preserve user input.

skills.title: Interaction and Motion
skills.description: Design purposeful interaction feedback and motion that clarify cause, state, continuity, and control.

skills.title: Interface Critique
skills.description: Critique an existing interface against user goals and return prioritized, evidence-based improvements.

skills.title: Loading, Empty, and Error States
skills.description: Design useful loading, empty, error, and recovery states that keep users oriented and able to act.

skills.title: Responsive Design
skills.description: Design and verify responsive interfaces that adapt content, interaction, and layout across constraints.
